scope: reaction-free constant-porosity analytical surface growth and bounded 1D DuMuX coupling
required_gates: zero evaporation gives zero growth and nonnegative evaporation gives nonnegative growth
zero-internal-reaction algebra agrees with an independently solved reaction-free BVP in its low-advection domain
large-Da_top asymptote and exact constant-flux height reference pass
porosity is exactly constant and internal precipitation is absent
seed activation conserves combined salt and water
trial evaluation is pure and crust commits once only after accepted DuMuX steps
40/80/160 vertical grids give converged top composition, evaporation and activation time
accepted-step salt and water budgets pass
adequate supply passes and insufficient supply is flagged without clipping growth
solution and moving-boundary Peclet conditions remain inside the declared domain
decision_rule: GO requires every gate. Any missing convergence, budget, supply or validity gate is NO-GO for 2D coupling.
